caption:
An uptrend is a staircase: higher highs and higher lows. Price climbs, pulls back, then climbs again from a higher floor.
So one red candle is not a reversal. It's often just the next pullback.
The level to watch is the last swing low. A drop below it is the first warning that the trend may be changing.
Did you know this? Yes or no.

Education only. Not financial advice.
